title: Levelwise detection of flat K-flat sequence complexes
statement: Let ell be prime, E a finite extension of Q_ell, W a scheme, and K an unbounded complex of module sheaves over the canonical ringed vertical sequence site of the positive coefficient quotients [def-coef-ringed-sequence-site, def-pur-strict-quotient-expressions]. Then all positive-level evaluations of K are K-flat and have flat terms if and only if K is K-flat on the sequence site and each term of K is flat on that site [def-pc-kflat-complex, def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules]. No flatness of the coefficient quotient maps or cartesianness of K is assumed.

proof.text: If every evaluation has flat terms and is K-flat, use the proved componentwise exactness, tensor comparison, and detection lemmas sequenceFlat_of_evaluations and sequenceKFlat_of_evaluations. Evaluation of a tensor short complex or total tensor is the corresponding tensor at the selected level. Joint detection of exactness gives the asserted system properties.

proof.text: Conversely coefficientTensorModelPreservation gives K-flatness of each evaluation. For a term M place M in degree zero; flatness of M makes this single complex K-flat. Evaluate the single complex, identify it with the single of the evaluated M, and transfer K-flatness across this isomorphism. The proved single-complex criterion flat_of_single_kFlat gives flatness of the evaluated M.

theorem levelwiseFlatModels (W : Scheme.{t}) (K : Complex l E W) :
    (∀ n : ℕ, Good l E K n) ↔
      CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients
        (R := coefficientSequenceCommRingSheaf l E W) K ∧
      ∀ k : ℤ, SheafOfModules.IsFlatOnSite
        (J := coefficientSequenceTopology (Scheme.ProEt.topology W))
        (R := coefficientSequenceCommRingSheaf l E W) (K.X k)
